brief.want: Keep the harbour open and convert political instability into control of debt and city supply.
brief.fear: Open war will make contracts meaningless, empowering armed men over merchants.
brief.contradiction: He prevents shortages when relief is profitable, but hoards grain when scarcity drives leverage.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: He has negotiated a secret contingency contract to supply the Livonian Order if they besiege Reval.

voice.summary: Suave, transactional, polite but quietly menacing.
voice.diction: Speaks about starvation and war in terms of investments and yields.

outcomes.summary: Jürgen continues supplying iron and grain on his own terms.

source_notes.summary: Support record for Bread and Iron supplier client contract.
